about: 2016 Census GCP G01/G07/G08/G09F/G09G/G09H/G14/G24/G28/G29/G33/G46B/G57B/G59 SA1 tables, pooled to New South Wales's 93 state electoral districts for the 23 March 2019 election (the 2013 redistribution's boundaries — nsw19 shares nsw15's district set, the census edition moved). Each SA1 counts whole to the district its polygon centroid lies in (boundary SA1s are not split; the state total is never moved; the SA1→district assignment is the join cache .build/map/nsw13/assign-sa1-2016.json, the same one the SEIFA lanes pool over). Bases match the federal stores (ex-not-stated): language other than English over English-only+other stated; age shares renormalised over G01's 11 bands (which exclude age-not-stated); overseas-born over country-stated, and the ten curated birthplace-country shares (cob, order in cobKeys) riding the same country-stated basis; university (bachelor and above) over the G01 aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; blue-collar (trades, machinery operators and drivers, labourers) over the eight stated ANZSCO groups; the new lane set mirrors the federal stores (year-12-or-less over G01's six printed stated schooling levels; G07 Tot-row Indigenous/ Indigenous-plus-non-Indigenous; G14's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons basis; G33's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis; G28's one-parent share of families; the under-15 share of the stated ages). Income lanes are the 2016 edition's 16-band grid in 2016 dollars, the state-universe quantile cuts New South Wales's own, computed per SA1 with the federal income lane's family-share arithmetic. p is census persons; n the SA1 count. The four NSW sentinel SA1s (migratory/offshore) carry no polygon and sit outside the join, holding 12701 persons statewide.
